title: Location context lib: reverse-geocode the capture location
userStory: As a user, my camera-captured receipt records where I was so the place auto-fills.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/locationContext.js exports getReceiptLocation({ location }) using an INJECTABLE location provider (real default lazily requires expo-location + When-In-Use permission; fake in tests). Granted -> { latitude, longitude, placeName, city, region, country }. Denied/unavailable/error -> null. Partial (position ok but reverse-geocode empty) -> coords with placeName:null (NOT null).
Exports attachLocation(receipt, locationContext) -> a NEW receipt with context.location (pure; input unmutated).
npm test passes (dep-free, network-blocked via the existing withNetworkBlocked pattern) with fakes covering granted / denied / partial, and attachLocation immutability.
